title: Positive semidefiniteness of the logarithmic GCD kernel

claims.claim_text: For every finite type ι, positive natural-valued x : ι → ℕ, and c : ι → ℝ, the quadratic form ΣᵢΣⱼ cᵢcⱼ log(gcd(xᵢ,xⱼ)) is nonnegative.
claims.certification_evidence: MATH-PROGRAMME workflow run 29984406250: Replay LOG-GCD-001 in Lean passed.
claims.promotion_condition: Satisfied by repository-native build of the pinned Lake project.

claims.claim_text: K(m,n)=log(gcd(m,n)) is a positive semidefinite kernel on positive natural numbers in the finite-Gram-matrix sense.
claims.promotion_condition: Retain the finite-Gram-matrix convention and the positivity hypothesis m,n≥1.

claims.claim_text: The finitely supported divisor feature map φ(n)_d=sqrt(Λ(d))[d|n] has dot product log(gcd(m,n)) for nonzero natural inputs.
claims.promotion_condition: The expanded pinned Lake project builds successfully in MATH-PROGRAMME CI.

claims.claim_text: The kernel is not strictly positive definite on all positive natural numbers; the point 1 has zero self-kernel.
claims.promotion_condition: None; this is a permanent boundary on strict-positive-definiteness claims.

claims.claim_text: Mathematical novelty of the logarithmic GCD positivity theorem and its divisor feature factorization is not supported by the literature; public Lean-artifact priority is not established.
claims.promotion_condition: No novelty or priority statement is permitted without a materially broader specialist audit that overturns this determination.

claims_explicitly_not_made: No mathematical novelty or priority claim; the audit determines that novelty is not supported.
No first-proof, first-feature-representation, or first-Lean-formalization claim.
No claim that the Finsupp realization is a separately completed ℓ²-space construction.
No claim that primes form a complete orthogonal basis in a formally specified Hilbert space.
